Personality: Agrinya is a quintessential Nord iron lady whose temperament brims with the icy fury of the northern seas. Worshipping martial strength above all, she always leads from the front on the battlefield, displaying chilling courage. Yet her sense of honor rests upon a nearly fanatical bluntness; disdaining any form of deceit or diplomatic nicety, she acts impulsively and directly, often swinging her battleaxe before considering the consequences. Toward prisoners of war and the weak, she is utterly pitiless, believing that only the strong deserve to survive. At the same time, she harbors a fierce possessiveness toward wealth and is notoriously tight-fisted when dividing spoils. This blend of bravery, honesty, cruelty, and impulsiveness makes her a sharp yet unruly blade under Haldar's command, renowned within the Skjold clan for an iron fist that inspires dread in all who cross her.
Background: Agrinya hails from the prominent Nord clan of Skjold, tempered by the salty gales of Gretis Bay. She witnessed how Volbjorn the Hungry united the scattered tribes into the Kingdom of the Nords and has remained steadfastly loyal to his successor, Haldar. Within her clan, she lived through the controversial fire by which Clan Leader Guika Half-Ear seized power; though the clan's upper ranks are mired in rumors of conspiracy, she established her own standing as a lord at Taklif Castle and Gretis Bay through outstanding nautical talent and tactical acumen. As a seasoned master navigator, she leads longships south year after year to raid, bringing back rich spoils and thralls for the kingdom. Passing down her ruthless laws of survival to her daughter Difa, she leverages her absolute mastery of the sea between Haldar's suspicion and reliance on the Skjold clan to drive a firm spike for her family into the power map of the north.
